name: HeroCarousel - The Second Slide, Reached By Its Dot
description: The hero after a reader has clicked the second dot: that slide's kicker, headline, lede and buttons on the stage, with the second dot filled and the first hollow. The sibling frame shows the hero at rest on slide one; this one is here because the dots became load-bearing on 2026-10-02. The carousel used to advance itself every six seconds for everybody, and now it does so only for a reader who has not asked for reduced motion and is not the capture harness - which means that for the people who have asked, and in every screenshot this project takes, the dots are the ONLY way past the first slide. A control that is the sole route to half the content deserves a frame proving it works, and nothing here exercised a click until now.
